projectDescription:
Deux citrouilles qui ne rentrent pas tout à fait dans le moule

Un duo de citrouilles fan-art : l'une coiffée des oreilles de Noctali, l'autre des oreilles rondes de Ronflex, avec leur visage souriant découpé dans la peau de la citrouille.

Ce produit est réalisé à la commande. Le délai d'expédition peut donc être plus long dans certains cas.

Quatre tailles disponibles

Chaque citrouille existe en 4, 6, 8 et 10 pouces, soit environ 10, 15, 20 et 25 cm : de quoi composer un alignement sur une étagère, une table de fête ou un rebord de fenêtre.

À illuminer

L'intérieur est creux : une bougie LED suffit à faire ressortir le visage découpé, sans aucun risque de flamme sur du plastique.

Couleurs imprimées

Le corps orange, la tige verte et le visage clair sont obtenus directement à l'impression, sans peinture.

⚠️ Attention : le plastique PLA utilisé pour cette impression est sensible aux températures dépassant les 60°C, ne pas exposer en plein soleil derrière une vitre et ne surtout pas laver au lave-vaisselle.

Ce modèle a été conçu par le créateur Yosh Studios et je possède la licence commerciale pour vendre des versions imprimées de ses créations.

Les couleurs de filament peuvent varier entre les visuels et le modèle réel suivant la marque et la gamme de PLA utilisé. Les visuels ci-contre sont des rendus générés numériquement et ne reflètent pas parfaitement le rendu final réel. Des photos de l'objet réel seront ajoutées dès que possible.

Spill-Proof Spruce
projectDescription:
I wanted to design a log slice coaster for a long time, but could never think of anything to make it extra cool, until this idea! The bark unrolls to become a handle which is specially designed to make it impossible to spill your drink!
This design took over 50 iterations to get it working perfectly. The articulating hinges, and gravity lock mechanism were particularly tricky to get working, but its finally ready!
How does it work?
Print in place hinges allow the bark to unroll. And a 90 degree hinge lets the handle rotate up and lock into place so you can carry your drinks!
Spill-Proof!
This design is spill proof, thanks to physics! The center of the handle is directly over the center of the mug, much makes it spill-proof thanks to centrifugal force! The stretchy hair tie also protects your mug from bouncing!
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.

Magnets hold the container together in the shape of a battery. When you need a battery, just lay it down unroll.
Make sure you don't store any of the batteries end to end!

creator: ForgeCore
folderPath: /media/ForgeCore/Trellis/Trellis Storage System - Base Bundle   Pegboard Alternative
projectDescription:
Trellis is a pegboard Alternative that looks great in any room. I wanted something that looked better than the standard pegboards. Something that I could use in my workshop or living room. This Trellis brings the aesthetic of a botanical garden with the functionality of a pegboard, making it perfect for any room in the house.
Trellis is great for storing tools, parts, and hardware. But its also perfect for displaying your prints & houseplants. Use a single Trellis and Shelf, for a nice plant shelf. Put multiple together for a pegboard alternative.
This system has 2 main advantages over any other printable storage wall.
1. It looks nice. Hidden seams and a natural form factor that lets it fit any room in your house.
2. It's simple. There's not thousands of pieces to figure out how they all work together. Which makes this system simple and easy to understand.  Just 1 Trellis Tile, 1 connector type, and your attachments
Note:
The Trellis does not move. It prints fused.
Base Bundle
This download includes the base bundle. Which has..
- The tileable Trellis
- Tray (and hooks)
- Shelf (Standard and Deep)
- Cups
But How does it work?
The Trellis connects to itself infinitely, so you can make your trellis as large (or small) as you want it. The trellis is it's own rail system, which allows you to easily slide your attachments into place. The attachments have grooves to slide down the trellis rails. Each attachment also has locking tabs so they stay put where you want them.
How do you Hang it?
You connect the Trellis pieces together using the included connectors. Everything will snap together. To Mount it on the wall, there are press-points that allow you to easily mark the screw holes to hang (Thanks Brian @ Lofted Goods)

Zoo are you
projectDescription:
Since starting the PlayBook’d series, we've wanted to create a deduction game that was simple to learn, fun for all ages, and looked great on a bookshelf. Zoo Are You? lets two players secretly choose an animal and race to figure out their opponent's mystery animal by asking clever yes-or-no questions.
Every question helps eliminate possibilities, so choosing the right question at the right time can make all the difference.
Disguised as a Book
This design blends right into your bookshelf, coffee table, or game shelf. But when you're ready to play, turn the page, open the book, and you're playing Zoo Are You?
How does it work?
Hidden flippers hide in the covers. Flippers in the pages of the book hold printed cards for each of the animals, and a snap on cover locks the paper in place.
Where are the animal images?
The character images are included as a printable PDF when you download. You just need to print them on paper and cut them out.
Easy Storage
No bulky box. No loose cards scattered everywhere.
The covers hold together with magnets, keeping everything secure inside when the game is closed. The animal tiles store neatly inside the book, making it easy to pack away, display, or bring with you.
How to Play
Each player secretly chooses one animal and places it in the hidden holder.
Open all of the animal flippers on your board.
Take turns asking yes-or-no questions to narrow down your opponent's mystery animal.
Flip down animals that no longer match the answers you've received.
When you think you know the answer, make your guess.
If you're right, you win!

projectDescription:
The classic game of Hook & Ring is now a book!  Hook & Ring is a super fun dexterity / skill game where the goal is to swing your ring onto the hook. You can play with the included pawn, or (if you're up for it) you can replace the pawn with a shot glass!
Disguised as a book
This design blends in on your bookshelf or table. But when you're ready to play, turn the page, open the book, and you're playing Hook & Ring.
How to Transform
To "deploy" the game, open the book and stand it up on the covers. The scoring plank will automatically drop down. After it does, move the pawn to the center circle. Then, pull up on the collapsible tower until it locks into place. Make sure the arms are in-line with the length of the spine. Then, rotate the arms up, and play! To close the book, repeat these steps in the opposite order.
Easy Storage
This looks like a book when you're not playing. So you can store it anywhere! And since the covers hold together with magnets, everything stays contained.
How to Play
Start with the pawn in the middle circle of the tray. The game beings after a 3 - 2 - 1 - GO!  Then race see who can swing their ring onto the hook. Once you get your ring onto your hook, you may advance the pawn 1 circle closer to your oppenent. But be quick, because they can move it back towards you if they get their ring on the hook. Keep going until the pawn "walks the plank" off the final circle. The player who advances all the way off their opponents side of the plank wins.
Alternative Hardware Option
If you don't want to purchase the metal rings, a normal keychain ring 1 inch keychain ring will work instead!

name: Tic Tac Toe
projectDescription:
The classic game of Tic Tac Toe is now a book!  Since I started the Playbook'd series, i've wanted to make tic tac toe into a book.
Tic Tac Toe is a classic paper / pen game. But the standard game is too simple. So we opted for ultimate tic tac toe for this book!
Not your average Tic Tac Toe
This is not just normal Tic Tac Toe, Its ultimate tic tac toe. A way more strategic, and fun version of tic tac toe. This is a Game in a Game. Where you try to win 3 mini-games in a row to win.
Disguised as a book
This design blends in on your bookshelf or table. But when you're ready to play, turn the page, open the book, and you're playing Tic Tac Toe.
Easy Storage
This looks like a book when you're not playing. So you can store it anywhere! And since the covers hold together with magnets, all your pieces are secure inside.
How to Play
The board: The board is made of 9 small tic-tac-toe boards arranged in a 3×3 grid.
Forced Moves: The space you choose sends your opponent to the matching small board next turn. Example: if you play in the top-right space inside a mini-game, your opponent must play in the top-right board.
X goes first and may play anywhere on the board
On your turn, place your mark in any open space of the mini game you’re sent to.
Win a mini-game by getting 3 in a row inside it.
Once a mini-game is won, Place your win-marker on that mini game. This claims your spot on the big board.
Win the game by winning 3 mini-games in a row on the big board.
If you’re sent to a board that is already won or full, you may play in any open board.
If a small board fills with no winner, it becomes a tie and no one claims it.

How to Play (Use special rules for a more fun game)
Start:
- Everyone chooses 1 marble, and start off of the board (the green circle is spot #1)
- Players each roll the dice once, highest roll goes first
Gameplay:
- Take turns rolling 1 die
- Move forward that many spaces
- If you land on the bottom of a ladder, climb up.
- If you land on the head of a snake, be sad, and fall down.
Special Rules:
- Bumps: If a player lands on someone elses space, you "bump" them one space forward.
- One: If you roll a 1, you may choose to move yourself OR another player 1 space forward
- Four: If you roll a 4, you may choose to move yourself forward OR backward 4 spaces.
Winning:
- First player to land on the Star by exact count wins!

Guesser: Guess a letter and flip up the cover to mark it as guessed. If you get it right, the executioner reveals a letter. If you get it wrong, they add a piece to the man. (8 guesses total, starting with the rope). Win by guessing the word before the man gets hung.

The classic game of LUDO is now a book!
Since starting the PlayBook’d series, we have had many requests to design LUDO and now we have. After a couple of iterations, I landed on this design that lets the colorful pieces really stand out on the covers and the pages.
LUDO is simple to learn, but every turn can change the game. Race your pieces around the board, send opponents back to start, and try to be the first player to bring all your pieces safely home.
Disguised as a Book
This design blends right into your bookshelf, coffee table, or game shelf. But when you're ready to play, turn the page, open the book, and you're playing LUDO.
Easy Storage
No bulky box. No loose pieces scattered everywhere.
The covers hold together with magnets, keeping everything secure inside when the game is closed. The game pieces store neatly inside the book, making it easy to pack away, display, or bring with you.
How to Play
Each player chooses a color and takes the matching pieces and places them in their start.
Players take turns rolling the die.
Roll a 6 to move one of your pieces out of start and onto the board.
Move your pieces around the track toward your home lane.
If you land on a space occupied by an opponent’s piece, the opponent's piece is sent back to their start.
If you land on a space occupied by your own piece, you form a blockade. While pieces form a blockade, opponents pieces can't move through it.
Once a piece completes the full path around the board, it enters into the home lane. To enter your home you must roll an exact dice roll. (To go three spaces you need a 3)
The first player to get all of their pieces home wins.
Would you rather watch a video? I found this one to be helpful!

name: PlayBook'd - Walls
projectDescription:
The classic strategy game of blocking paths and racing to the other side is now a book! Place walls to slow down your opponent while finding the fastest route across the board.
Disguised as a Book
This design blends in on your bookshelf or coffee table. But when you’re ready to play, open the covers, set up the board, and begin building you're playing Walls.
Easy Storage
The pawns store securely inside the covers, while individual compartments keep all the walls organized and ready for the next game. When playtime is over, everything packs neatly back inside the book.
How to Play (2 Players)
Each player places their pawn on the center space along opposite sides of the board.
Each player starts with 10 walls.
On your turn, choose one action:
Move your pawn one space.
Place a wall between spaces to block part of your opponent’s path. (walls can be placed horizontally or vertically on the board)
Walls can make the journey more difficult, but every player must always have at least one open path to the opposite side.
The first player to move their pawn to any space on the opposite side of the board wins!
The game can be played with up to 4 players. Divde the number of walls between players evently. Each player starts on the middle square of their edge of the board. Take turns clockwise.
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.

name: Clematis Ivy
projectDescription:
Clematis Ivy is a climbing plant, and now it climbs up your fridge! Clematis is known for its stunning star-shaped blooms, which makes this a great print if you want a pop of color on your fridge year-round. My Fridge is always a mess with a bunch of different ugly magnets and I wanted something that looked great, but could also organize all the stuff on my fridge. This Clematis Ivy was a great solution that adds a little garden charm to the kitchen.
You can take the leaves or flowers off the stem to use as a single magnet, or for bigger items pin them beneath the stem.
Prints-in-Place
The stems of the Clematis Ivy print in place! Thanks to some specially designed hinges. Each stem section has multiple joints allowing you to wind it back and forth on your fridge. All you have to do is add magnets.
Customizability
The stems all snap together, so you can easily make your Ivy as long as you want. There are also Y branches so you can branch off your vine in multiple directions, just like the real thing!
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.

The classic game of Tumbling Tower is now a book! Stack up the blocks, then take turns pulling one out and putting it on top without knocking it over. For this design, I made the blocks the same weight as real wood and gave them a wood grain texture, so the game feels just like the real one.
Comes with a Stacking Sleeve
Setting up a tumbling tower by hand can be tricky, so we designed a foldable tower setter. It fits inside of the book like a page, but you can unfold it to turn into a sleeve to make it easier to stack your blocks..
Play Anywhere
You can use the book as your table. which lets you play anywhere, like on carpet on grass, or even on sand.
Easy Storage
The blocks have slots inside the book, and the Stacking Sleeve folds flat into a page. The covers hold together with magnets, so everything stays contained and the whole game packs right back onto the shelf.
How to Play
Players: 2 or more
Build the tower three blocks per layer, turning each layer 90 degrees from the one below it.
On your turn, take one block from anywhere below the 2 highest completed layers, using only one hand, and place it ontop of the tower.
Keep going until the tower falls. Whoever knocks it over loses, and the player who went right before them wins!
How does the wood texture work?
The wood texture is applied using a modifier object that uses a combination of settings to created the wood grain look.
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.

name: Bath Lilies
projectDescription:
Bath Lilies
I designed a Lily pad for holding your drink when you're at the pool, but I made some changes so you can use this in the Bath Tub! The Wine Lily holds your wine while you're relaxing in the bath. And the CandleLily lets you float candles around the tub.
The lily pads float super well and are really stable making them ideal for keeping your candles afloat and your drink close. Make sure to print them with 5 walls to keep them water tight. And use 8% infill for added bouyancy
WineLily
The WineLily uses a lotus mechanism that automatically grabs onto your wine glass to keep it from spilling. I also added a slot in the lily so that you can use with with stemmed wine glasses as well.
CandleLily
The CandleLily is designed to hold and float standard tea light candles. Making your bath more relaxing. They are raised off the water so your light won't be put out accidentally.

projectDescription:

projectDescription:
There are many different types of crossword games, but now there's a book version!  Crosswords is a game of intelligence game where the goal is spell words to get the most points. This game can be played with up to 4 people.
Disguised as a book
This design blends in on your bookshelf or table. But when you're ready to play, turn the page, open the book, and you're playing crosswords.
How to Transform
To "deploy" the game, open the book and stand it up on the covers. Remove the magnet tile racks from the storage, and dump the tiles out. Each player can snap their tile rack onto one of the 4 spots on the board, and the tiles should be placed face down between the covers.
Easy Storage
This looks like a book when you're not playing. So you can store it anywhere! And since the covers hold together with magnets, everything stays contained.
How to Play
This game play's just like standard crossword-spelling games. Instructions are in the images above
3L= Triple letter score
2L = Double letter score
2W = Double word score
3W = Triple word score
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.

Ladder Ball
projectDescription:
The classic game of Ladder Ball is now a book!  Ladder Ball is typically an outdoor game, but if you shrink it down, and store it inside of a book, it becomes a perfect coffee table sport.
Disguised as a book
This design blends in on your bookshelf or table. But when you're ready to play, turn the page, open the book, and you're playing Ladder Ball.
Easy Storage
This looks like a book when you're not playing. So you can store it anywhere, and since the covers hold together with magnets, all your pieces are secure inside.
How to Play
This game is played just like normal ladder ball, just with 1 ladder.
Set up the Ladder on a table or coffee table and stand 5 feet away.
Take turns tossing the balls at the ladder. Red Vs Blue.
Wrap them around the rungs to score points:
Top = 3
Middle = 2
Bottom = 1.
After both players throw all the balls, add up the points. This game is played where points cancel each round.
Continue playing rounds until someone wins by reaching 21 points!
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.
Commercial Seller Notice: This design uses magnets. Sellers are responsible for safe assembly, secure magnet retention, labeling, testing, and legal compliance for any finished products they sell. Do not sell as a children's toy unless it meets applicable safety standards.

projectDescription:
The classic game of Cornhole is now a book!  Cornhole is a super fun precision / skill game where the goal is to toss your bean bags into the hole on the board. For this design, I created a 3D printable cornhole bag that plays and feels exactly like a real cornhole bag.
Disguised as a book
This design blends in on your bookshelf or table. But when you're ready to play, turn the page, open the book, and you're playing Cornhole.
How to Transform
To "deploy" the game, open the book, and drop the legs. Then press the lock on the spine down to hold the book open. Push out the corn hole from the cover and grab your bags! To close the book, repeat these steps in the opposite order.
Easy Storage
This looks like a book when you're not playing. So you can store it anywhere! And since the covers hold together with magnets, everything stays contained.
How to Play
Players: 2 to 4 players
Place the board at the end of a counter top or card table and stand opposite of it. Where you agree to stand is the foul line.
Players take turns throwing their bags at the board. bags on the board are worth 1 point, bags in the hole are worth 3 points, and dead bags (not on the board or through the hole) are worth 0 points.
After all 8 bags are thrown in a round, tally the points for both teams. The scores cancel each other out, and only the team with the higher score gets the difference.
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.

Trellis brings the aesthetic of a botanical garden with the functionality of a pegboard. This Bundle focuses on Plant Lovers. With Planters, grow light mounts, and printable plant ties!
Botanical Bundle
This download includes the Botanical Bundle which has..
- Planter Pot
- Planter Box
- Growlight Mount
- Plant Ties
- Adapter For use with Lofted Goods Pots
Both planters Include removable drip trays, so you can water your plants right on the wall without taking them down.
Use the Plant Ties to climb your plants up the Trellis. They're also great for securing your growlight chords!
The included adapter allows your to use and Lofted Goods Wall Mounted Pot.
Explore more pot styles: Lofted Goods Pots Use Code LOFTEDPOTS for 20% off a lofted goods membership
What's Trellis?
Trellis is a pegboard Alternative that looks great in any room. I wanted something that looked better than the standard pegboards. Something that I could use in my office, workshop, and even living room. This Trellis brings the aesthetic of a botanical garden with the functionality of a pegboard, making it perfect for any room in the house.
Trellis is great for storing tools, parts, and hardware. But its also perfect for displaying your prints & houseplants. Use a single Trellis and Shelf, for a nice plant shelf. Put multiple together for a pegboard alternative.
But How does it work?
The Trellis connects to itself infinitely, so you can make your trellis as large (or small) as you want it. The trellis is it's own rail system, which allows you to easily slide your attachments into place. The attachments have grooves to slide down the trellis rails. Each attachment also has locking tabs so they stay put where you want them.

projectDescription:
Note: The tiles in this set are smaller than standard Mahjong tiles. Tiles from other sets will not work with this set.
Custom-designed tiles, pot storage, bamboo tile racks. This Bamboo Mahjong set has everything you could want in an American Mahjong set.
This design is compatible with American Mahjong.
New to American Mahjong?
Watch this video guide on how to play
Bamboo Racks
American Mahjong is known for its long racks, which hold your tiles and include pushers to move your wall forward. Since the racks are long and skinny, bamboo was the perfect fit.
When you’re ready to play, extend each bamboo shoot by pulling out the leaves. Use the extended bamboo rack to build your wall. When it’s time to push your wall forward, rotate the leaves out to use them as the pusher.
Pot Storage
All of the tiles store inside the pot. Just lift the stones to access them. When you’re done playing, place everything back inside the pot until next time.
All 152 Tiles
American mahjong has a lot of different tiles, and this set includes custom designs for all of them.
Dots: 1-9
Craks: 1-9
Bams: 1-9
Flowers: 4 styles
Winds: 4 directions
Dragons: 3 suits
The tiles in this set are smaller than standard Mahjong tiles. Tiles from other sets will not work with this set. This designed around the build volume of 3D printers, which meant the tile racks and pushers had to stay within certain size limits, and as a result the tiles are a bit smaller than standard sets.

name: Cocoasters
creator: ForgeCore
projectDescription:
This design was inspired by those viral wood coasters that you've probably seen. An aesthetic way to store your coasters during the holidays. Each branch comes off the trunk and collapses down into a coaster!
These are perfect for using around the holidays. Add the star on top for some extra Christmas vibes. Or take it off for a more "evergreen" appearance to use it year round.
How does it work?
The coasters each have 2 hair ties in them so they pop up when there isn't a mug. They stack onto the tree trunk!
More Hidden Features?
This design is more than just coasters for your hot chocolate! The Trunk is actually a secret Marshmallow Musket! Load mini marshmallows into the base of the trunk, pull it back and launch marshmallows into your hot chocolate!
What about the star on top? Its actually a Star Stirrer! Stick any standard coffee stirrer into the star, and use it to stir your drink!

projectDescription:
This is the 2nd generation of Snack Attack! The original was the first board game I designed, and since we have gotten a lot better at desgining, we re-created a much improved version! name: Reversi
creator: ForgeCore
projectDescription:
The classic game of Reversi is now a book. Reversi is a personal favorite of mine, Its so fun to flip over a bunch of chips in a row to claim them as your color.
This is my 8th addition to PlayBook'd.
Note: This book uses different magnets than the first 7 Playbook'd books. These are much stronger and eliminate the need for rubber feet!
Disguised as a book
This design blends in on your bookshelf or table. But when you're ready to play, turn the cover and you're playing Reversi. The book folds open revealing a beautiful board. There are long slots to hold all of your Reversi Chips. The cover is magnetized on, and swivels open so you can slide out the pieces.
How to Play
Reversi is played by two players on an 8×8 board using black and white discs. The game starts with four discs in the center: two black and two white arranged diagonally. Black goes first.
On your turn, place one disc on the board so that it brackets one or more of your opponent’s discs in a straight line (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) between the disc you place and another one of your discs. All bracketed opponent discs are flipped to your color. If you cannot make a legal move, you must pass.
The game ends when neither player can make a move. The player with the most discs on the board wins.

Video Version of the Rules
Easy Storage
Since this looks like a book when you're not playing. You can store it anywhere. And since the covers hold together with magnets, all your pieces are secure inside. Just open the book to play, and shut the book to put it away.

projectDescription:
A piggy bank that's actually a plant? This Figgy Bank is a super fun way to save your money. The coin vortex at the bottom makes it super fun to put coins into your bank.
Quarters and Nickels can be dropped from the top. Pennies and dimes are small and should be dropped from the root at the bottom, since they dont need as much speed, and will fall out of the trunk.

name: Bonsai 365 Tree Calendar
creator: ForgeCore
projectDescription:
I've wanted to design a bonsai tree ever since making my first plant design. But I wanted to wait until i had a great idea for what it's function should be: which turned out to be this Calendar!
Bonsai trees are a visual representation of the passage of time. They are grown and pruned over decades. So what better plant to represent a calendar than a Bonsai? This was modeled after is a Japanese Maple, known for their uniquely shaped red leaves.
On the first of the month you start with a bare tree. And each day the tree gets a new leaf so you can watch your month bloom.
How to use?
To start the month, remove all the leaves from the tree. On the first day of the month, place the 1st leaf in front of the rock in the pot. Then on the 2nd day, swap leaf 1 with leaf 2 and place it on the tree. Repeat each day of the month to keep track of the date and to watch your tree bloom! At the end of the month, swap the month  card inside of the rock.
How does the pot work?
The pot, drawer, and leaf lifters all print in place. The drawer is pushed out to one side to allow you to grab your month card and leaf for your tree. There are lifters to help you life your leaf out of the drawer.

projectDescription:
La coiffure la plus reconnaissable du manga

Un casque fan-art inspiré de Majin Vegeta, coiffure en pointes sculptée d'un bloc et marque M sur le front.

Ce produit est réalisé à la commande. Le délai d'expédition peut donc être plus long dans certains cas.

Ce produit est sur mesure : lors de votre commande, merci d'indiquer votre tour de tête (en cm) pour que je redimensionne le modèle afin qu'il s'adapte au mieux à votre tête.

Yeux au choix

Deux options pour les yeux : une version pleine, plus fidèle au modèle d'origine, ou une version maillée qui permet de voir au travers et de le porter toute une soirée.

Vérifiez la taille avant impression

Un gabarit est fourni pour valider la taille avant de lancer l'impression complète.

⚠️ Attention : le plastique PLA utilisé pour cette impression est sensible aux températures dépassant les 60°C, ne pas exposer en plein soleil derrière une vitre et ne surtout pas laver au lave-vaisselle.

Ce modèle a été conçu par le créateur Yosh Studios et je possède la licence commerciale pour vendre des versions imprimées de ses créations.

Les couleurs de filament peuvent varier entre les visuels et le modèle réel suivant la marque et la gamme de PLA utilisé. Les visuels ci-contre sont des rendus générés numériquement et ne reflètent pas parfaitement le rendu final réel. Des photos de l'objet réel seront ajoutées dès que possible.

projectDescription:
Gotham en briques, sous votre casque

Un présentoir fan-art qui reprend le style des briques Lego : façade d'immeuble, symbole de la chauve-souris et socle en deux parties.

Ce produit est réalisé à la commande. Le délai d'expédition peut donc être plus long dans certains cas.

Assorti au casque Lego

Il est dessiné pour recevoir le casque Batman style Lego de la même gamme, mais accueille n'importe quel casque de taille comparable.

Multicolore sans peinture

Chaque élément est imprimé dans sa couleur : les aplats restent nets et ne s'écaillent pas avec le temps.

⚠️ Attention : le plastique PLA utilisé pour cette impression est sensible aux températures dépassant les 60°C, ne pas exposer en plein soleil derrière une vitre et ne surtout pas laver au lave-vaisselle.

Ce modèle a été conçu par le créateur Yosh Studios et je possède la licence commerciale pour vendre des versions imprimées de ses créations.

Les couleurs de filament peuvent varier entre les visuels et le modèle réel suivant la marque et la gamme de PLA utilisé. Les visuels ci-contre sont des rendus générés numériquement et ne reflètent pas parfaitement le rendu final réel. Des photos de l'objet réel seront ajoutées dès que possible.

projectDescription:
A flower that helps you decide what to do on date night. This flower is modeled after a Daisy, with 16 petals that spin so you can choose a random date idea.
- - Please spin very carefully. This is delicate like a real flower! - -
No More Arguments!
Can't decide what to do for your date? Give the flower a spin and let it decide. Grab the flower at the top and that's what you're doing for your date.
Customizable
The file is set up so you can edit the text if you want to add different date ideas.
How does it work?
The petals have magnets inside so they stick to the bearings. The flower has 2 bearings which spin freely, so you can give the petals a spin to randomize your date.
Save your Date
The pot has storage inside for saving momentos from your dates. Its a great way to remember and reminisce on your past dates!
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.
Commercial Seller Notice: This design uses magnets. Sellers are responsible for safe assembly, secure magnet retention, labeling, testing, and legal compliance for any finished products they sell. Do not sell as a children's toy unless it meets applicable safety standards.

name: Fizzy Frog
creator: ForgeCore
projectDescription:
I designed the frog can cover to stop bugs from getting in my drinks. Snap the frog over the can, and close the head to keep bees and fly's away. The lid also prevents excess spills.
But how does it work?
The frog is attached to the head with a hinge. So it can swing over the can and lock on. Its designed to work with any standard sized can, and just snaps into place over the top of the can.
Use in the Pool?
This was designed with the Lily Pad Cupholder in mind. The Lily pad cupholder keeps your drink afloat in the pool. And this frog works perfect with it. The petals still grab onto the can securely even when the frog is on top of your can.
Where did the idea come from?
I really wanted something to cover my drink while i was using my Lily Pad cupholder in the pool to keep pool water from splashing inside of it. And what else should live on a lily pad than a frog?

projectDescription:
The best way to keep your desk clean. This little dumpster holds way more trash than it seems!
Throw all your trash inside the dumpster and watch it dissapear. You can print it in blue for a recyling dumpster, since it fits cans as well.
Garbage Chute
This dumpster has a garbage chute, that goes through your desk and into a much larger garbage can. Which keeps your desk tidy while all the trash magically dissapears below. The garbage chute fits inside cable ports that are 80+ mm.
Desk Mounted
The trash can twist-locks onto the garbage chute. So you can take it off and empty it whever you need. And since the can hangs from the desk, it doesn't get in the way of your feet under your desk.

name: Desktop Golf Gen 2
projectDescription:
This perfect desk game has been reimagined. The first generation of desktop golf was our first mega-viral video. With this design, we rethought it in every way to make it as functional and beautiful as possible.
A Real Golfer!
Desktop golf now has a golfer!. The golfer pivots around his waist like a real golfer. Swing him however you want (hold the club, spin his waist, or even pivot him my his head). Whatever you need to do to hit a good shot.
Dream Green
This putting green is a dream. It features:
- Bunkers that return the ball back to you.
- A rock wall to keep all balls on the green.
- Beatuful mower lines thanks to fuzzy printing.
Ball Return
The ball comes back! Any shot that makes it to the green automatically comes back to the tee box thanks to a return tube that goes under the desk. The green is speficially design to funnel all misses into one of the bunker holes which all slope into the return tube.
No cable port? No problem
We want everyone to be able to play desktop golf, even if your desk doesnt have a cable port. So we designed it to also clamp on the back of a desk!
Perfect for Father's Day
At the time of release, Father's day is coming soon! Customize the colors of the golfer to look like the dad in your life. Then gift them the ultimate desktop toy.
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.
Commercial Seller Notice: This design uses magnets. Sellers are responsible for safe assembly, secure magnet retention, labeling, testing, and legal compliance for any finished products they sell. Do not sell as a children's toy unless it meets applicable safety standards.

This Wall Mounted Controller Holder is print in place. Screw the rails into the wall and slide the holder overtop of it! Perfect for saving space on your desk and displaying your controllers.
After you print it, the hinges should swing freely, and you'll need to break the smaller hinges free with some pressure. You may notice some stringing inside the smaller hinges, which can be removed with some snips.
There are 2 rail types. The Base Rail has a stopper to hold up all the controller holders, so use just one of those as the bottom rail
name: Gaming Wall Mount
creator: ForgeCore

projectDescription:
This game is a reimagination of the standard wooden tumbling tower games where you pull blocks and stack them up. The old version of this game was stale, boring, and bland looking, so I made a better version, made a kid-friendly theme, and spiced it up with added elements!
Printing this game requires a decent amount of time. But it is SO worth it to print and play, we've had so much fun playing it.
Themed Storage
I wanted this game to be self contained. And what better to store ice cream than an ice cream gallon. The decoration on the stroage is made with fuzzy skin, which means you don't need a multicolor printer!
Unique Gameplay
This game is played similar to any tumbling tower game with some added twists. The main one is Neopolitan scoops. If you create a Neopolitan layer, you get to choose the flavor the next person must pull. This adds a level of stategy the original game needed.
Items Included:
Container
36 Ice Cream pieces
Ice Cream Cone
Cherry

Trellis brings the aesthetic of a botanical garden with the functionality of a pegboard. This Bundle focuses on the Entry Way. With key holders, sunglasses storage, and hooks. Making it a great bundle for your front door, entry way, or anywhere you need to drop your stuff when you get home.
Entry Way Bundle
This download includes the Entry Way Bundle which has..
- Sunglasses Shelf
- Hook Cup
- Cactikey Adapter For use with Cactikeys
What's Trellis?
Trellis is a pegboard Alternative that looks great in any room. I wanted something that looked better than the standard pegboards. Something that I could use in my office, workshop, and even living room. This Trellis brings the aesthetic of a botanical garden with the functionality of a pegboard, making it perfect for any room in the house.
Trellis is great for storing tools, parts, and hardware. But its also perfect for displaying your prints & houseplants. Use a single Trellis and Shelf, for a nice plant shelf. Put multiple together for a pegboard alternative.
But How does it work?
The Trellis connects to itself infinitely, so you can make your trellis as large (or small) as you want it. The trellis is it's own rail system, which allows you to easily slide your attachments into place. The attachments have grooves to slide down the trellis rails. Each attachment also has locking tabs so they stay put where you want them.

projectDescription:
I wanted to design a better way to hold your glasses without stretching out your shirt collar or needing a pocket, so I created the CaterClip! I am really happy with how this little guy came out.
The inchworm uses magnets glued inside his feet to attach to a leaf hidden inside your shirt. The inchworm’s body creates the perfect place to hang your glasses.
Magnetic Attachment
Place the leaf inside your shirt and attach the inchworm from the outside using the glued-in magnets. The leaf helps spread out the weight while keeping the inchworm securely in place. I tried my best to dislodge my glasses and never succeeded with this design.
Note: For this to work in any orientation, insert the magnets with oposite polarity,
Make sure to use strong N52 rated magnets!
Wear It Anywhere
The inchworm can be placed almost anywhere on your shirt, so you can position your glasses wherever they feel most comfortable and accessible.
How it Works
The curved body securely holds your glasses while making it look like a little inchworm is crawling across your shirt. It is a fun alternative to hanging your glasses from your collar, where they can stretch the fabric or easily fall off.
Easy Quick Print
This design only needs 4 magnets, 10 grams of filament and is a super fast print.
Extra Large (XL) version included
The file includes and XL version of the inchworm and leaf, incase you thick-frame sunglasses
This design contains magnets and should be kept away from children and pets.
Commercial Seller Notice: This design uses magnets. Sellers are responsible for safe assembly, secure magnet retention, labeling, testing, and legal compliance for any finished products they sell. Do not sell as a children's toy unless it meets applicable safety standards.

Fidget Foliage
projectDescription:
I've designed a bunch of functional plants in the past. But this time around I wanted to do something that's just for fun, that still will look great on a desk, shelf, counter etc. These Fidget Foliage were perfect to do just that.
But how do they work?
The plants print flat and then roll up to go inside of the pot. This technique was shared from Elle Stvdio! The Pot is actually a print in place ratchet. So once you put the plant inside, you can spin the top of the pot to be super satisfied! Just be careful when you break the mechanism free that you are spinning it in the correct direction.
Quick and Easy Printing
This print is super fast, and super easy. Nothing takes more than a few hours to print. And they use up very little filament.
